declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (lifecycle : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustLifecycle)
  (verificationRevision : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustRevision)
  (publication : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinSinkAcceptance.SinkBoundPublication Digest)
  (receipt : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleAcceptanceReceipt verifier),
  ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.CanAcknowledgeWithLifecycle verifier lifecycle
      verificationRevision publication receipt →
    receipt.identity.delivery.sinkId = publication.sinkId ∧
      receipt.identity.delivery.protocolVersion = publication.protocolVersion ∧
        receipt.identity.delivery.edge = publication.bundle.obligation.edge ∧
          verifier.verifies receipt.identity receipt.evidence ∧
            ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.CanAuthorizeCurrent lifecycle
              verificationRevision receipt.identity
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.lifecycle_acknowledgement_requires_bound_verified_current_identity

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (lifecycle : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustLifecycle)
  (verificationRevision : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustRevision)
  (publication : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinSinkAcceptance.SinkBoundPublication Digest)
  (receipt : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleAcceptanceReceipt verifier)
  (admitted :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.CanAcknowledgeWithLifecycle verifier lifecycle
      verificationRevision publication receipt),
  (ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.acknowledgeWithLifecycle verifier lifecycle

    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinPublicationOutbox.PublicationPhase.acknowledged
declarations.name: ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.lifecycle_verified_receipt_closes_obligation

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (lifecycle : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustLifecycle)
  (verificationRevision : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustRevision)
  (identity : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustBoundIdentity Digest),
  verificationRevision < identity.issuedAtRevision →
    ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.CanAuthorizeCurrent lifecycle verificationRevision
        identity

  (verificationRevision : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustRevision)
  (identity : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustBoundIdentity Digest),
  identity.trustEpoch ≠ lifecycle.currentEpoch →

          identity

declarations.type:

declarations.type:
∀ {Digest : Type} (verifier : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleVerifier Digest)
  (lifecycle : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustLifecycle)
  (receipt : ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.LifecycleAcceptanceReceipt verifier)
  (verificationRevision effectiveRevision :
    ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.TrustRevision),
  verifier.verifies receipt.identity receipt.evidence →
    lifecycle.revokedAt receipt.identity.trustEpoch = some effectiveRevision →
      receipt.identity.issuedAtRevision < effectiveRevision →
        effectiveRevision ≤ verificationRevision →
          ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.HistoricallyValid verifier lifecycle receipt ∧
            ¬ASPProof.SearchRouteAdmissionRetryCacheRejoinVerifierLifecycle.CanAuthorizeCurrent lifecycle
                verificationRevision receipt.identity
